messages:
riley: Heads-up: a handful of customers reported SCIM deprovision fails after today's RBAC tweak + SAML mapping change. Errors show 403 + KMS InvalidCiphertext for some tenant blobs. Anyone on the RBAC change?

samir: I pushed the RBAC delta (tightened provisioner perms) at 2026-07-10T14:05Z. The intent was to remove admin actions but I included a deny for kms:Decrypt in the new managed policy. Might be related.

dev-kai: Correlating logs: scim-provisioner shows AccessDenied on KMS Decrypt for some tenants and InvalidCiphertext for others. Snippet: 
```
2026-07-10T14:22:41Z ERROR scim-provisioner tenant=orca deprov=failed status=403 reason=decrypt_failed
2026-07-10T14:22:41Z ERROR kms: Decrypt key=alias/scim-secrets err=InvalidCiphertextException ctx={\"site\":\"eu-west\"}
```

security-bot: Detected IAM change by samir at 2026-07-10T14:05Z: policy "provisioner-restrict" added deny kms:Decrypt for principals not in admin group. Flagged medium risk since scim uses kms for tenant secrets.

oncall-maya: I'm oncall. Two paths: 1) temporary KMS grant that permits Decrypt for svc/scim-provisioner, 2) rollback RBAC patch, 3) rewrap blobs that fail decryption if context mismatch. Which do we prefer?

riley: Quick mitigation = grant so backfills succeed. Long-term = correct policy and add CI check. Also need to check if any tenant blobs were unreadable (InvalidCiphertext) which implies encryption-context mismatch from earlier mapping change.

samir: I'll roll a targeted exception into the policy, but want to avoid long-lived perms. If grant is faster, oncall-maya please create time-limited grant and record audit id.

oncall-maya: Creating grant now: `aws kms create-grant --key-id key/0a1b --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scim-provisioner --operations Decrypt --name temp-scim-decrypt-1767899999` and restarting pods after.

security-bot: Emergency grant created by oncall-maya at 2026-07-10T14:45Z. Audit ID=G-2217. Policy change by samir noted.

dev-kai: After restart, backfill progress improved. However ~7 tenants still show InvalidCiphertextException — likely encryption-context keys changed when we changed SAML mapping (NameID format) last week. Those need rewrap.

riley: OK split tasks: samir - patch RBAC and add unit test that forbids removing kms:Decrypt for scim-provisioner (owner). dev-kai - run a targeted rewrap tool for the 7 tenants (owner). oncall-maya - revoke grant after backfills done (owner). compliance-ian - collect CloudTrail, grant audit, and change diffs for packet (owner).

compliance-ian: Will collect artifacts. Also request: timestamped list of affected tenants and replay logs for any attempted deprovisions during the window.

samir: Opening PR to add an explicit allow statement for scim-provisioner with kms:Decrypt and adding `rcli iam simulate` as a CI gate. PR: https://git.redwood/iam/PR-832.

dev-kai: Rewrap tool plan: decrypt with old context map (we’ve stored rotation-contexts in infra/audit/contexts.csv), then encrypt with canonical context {tenant_id}. I'll run on staging first and then prod in maintenance window.

oncall-maya: Backfill finished; deprovision success rates normalized. I'll tear down the grant at 2026-07-10T16:00Z and post the revoke audit id.

security-bot: Recommend runbook updates: 1) RBAC PR checklist must include KMS-dependency simulation, 2) rotation tooling must persist previous encryption-contexts, 3) add alerts for KMS InvalidCiphertext spikes and KMS AccessDenied for scim-provisioner.

riley: Agreed. Triage severity: configuration + RBAC misstep -> medium. Schedule 30m postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC to review root cause and remediation timeline. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
